description: Revision Kohn-Sham solver (Revision/kohn_sham/solver): instantaneous Kohn-Sham states of dirac16complex in the author's primordial field, the author's metric with b4(x4) in the extra-time components (b4 a function of x4, never 1), along the deflating history a4 = H x4, b4 = b4(0) e^{(4/3) H x4} (SPEC sections 1 and 7, Revision/kohn_sham/ks-theory.json). The author's coordinates {x0, ..., x7}: x0 = hidden direction (y = ln(sin z)/(6H), z = 6 H x0), x1..x3 = 3-space, x4 = time, x5..x7 = the exponentially deflating extra times (scale factor e^{-a4} b4^{1/2} sin^{1/6} z ~ e^{-a4/3} on the history).

theoryInputs.adiabaticityHistory: a4 = A H x4 (A = 1 canonical), b4 = b4(0) e^{beta A H x4} (beta = 4/3), a4' = A H, b4'/b4 = beta A H; slices a4,0 = a4(x4), b4,0 = b4(0) e^{beta a4,0}; PRESCRIBED BACKGROUND (see historyStatus)

units: H = 1, m = 1: energies, momenta, temperatures in units of m = H. b4(0) enters only as a unit (ks-theory.json densities.proper): lambda = lambda_hat = lambda b4(0)^{-3/2} in units of m^-6, the same at every slice; Vol_7(a4,0) = ell^3 v_t e^{(3/2) beta a4,0} (the proper 7-volume of the cell per unit e^{6Hy} in units of b4(0)^{3/2} H^-7); every density, profile and pressure is the proper one times b4(0)^{3/2}; energies, levels, potentials, particle numbers and the integrals 2 Vol_7 int e^{6Hy} (...) dy are the physical ones. Equivalently (ks-theory.json densities.couplingVolumeScaling) a slice state is the state of the coordinate cell ell^3 v_t at lambda_eff = lambda_hat e^{-2 a4,0}

physics.Vol7Rule: Vol_7(a4,0) = ell^3 v_t e^{(3/2) beta a4,0}

particleNumbers.rule: N = 8 (the k = 0 brane zero modes, both block types); N_large = the largest closed shell of the free a4,0 = 0 aufbau whose last filled level lies below the bulk edge (the lowest level not on the even j = +1 brane band: min of the odd l = 0 and even l = 1 levels at k = 0); N_mid = the closed shell (>= 8, below the bulk edge) nearest N_large / 4

couplingCalibration.rule: per N, from the free ground states of that N at every slice a4,0 of the history: strength = max over the slices and over y of max((15/16)|S(y)|, |n(y)|/16) (the solver's densities, per Vol_7(a4,0), which grows like b4^{3/2} = b4(0)^{3/2} e^{2 a4,0}), the first-order mean-field potential per unit lambda_hat; lambda_1 = 0.1/strength and lambda_2 = 0.3/strength rounded to 4 significant digits, so that the first-order mean-field potential stays below 0.1 m and 0.3 m along the whole history (strengthPerLambdaAtSlices shows at which slice it is largest); lambda_hat = lambda b4(0)^{-3/2} is a constant of the theory, the same at every slice

conventions.particleNumber: N = sum g f over both brane parities = particle number of the doubled (universe + Z2 image) system; the patch holds N/2 (ks-theory.json densities.total). The thermodynamics line 'mu fixed by sum w_Z2 g f = N' of ks-theory.json is inconsistent with this and with its own Omega = -T sum g ln(...) + ..., F = Omega + mu N; the solver uses sum g f = N (noted as a discrepancy of the theory file)
conventions.filling: particles occupy the positive branch (labels whose lambda = 0 level at the same slice is positive) and the k = 0 brane zero modes (CONVENTION of ks-theory.json, justification OPEN); the negative branch is the normal-ordered sea and is not populated thermally (the excluded thermal sea holes are reported as a diagnostic)
conventions.brane: Z2 mirror at y = 0: ASSUMED (b(0) = 0 even, a(0) = 0 odd); tip: regular, theta = 0 (b(-L) = 0)
conventions.instantaneous: states at fixed a4,0 = a4(x4) are instantaneous (adiabatic) Kohn-Sham states; the non-adiabatic (time-dependent) problem is OPEN
conventions.history: PRESCRIBED BACKGROUND: the history a4 = H x4, b4 = b4(0) e^{(4/3) H x4} is prescribed, not solved for. With the author's Lovelock weights the a4 and b4 equations of SPEC section 5 allow it only with the constant source kappa (rho, p3, p_t, p0) = (-2/27, -2/9, -22/27, -14/27) (Revision/field_equations_a4/a4-equations.json, exponentialHistory.authorWeights.historySource); the Kohn-Sham states along it do not supply this source (they depend on x0 and change with a4,0: Revision/field_equations_a4/reports/ks-source-conditions.json). The Kohn-Sham gas is therefore a test field on a prescribed background without back-reaction, and quantities derived along this history (energies, pressures, equations of state) are not consequences of the coupled field equations. (ks-theory.json adiabaticity.historyStatus)
conventions.b4: b4 does not enter the slice Hamiltonian h (ks-theory.json sectorAndAnsatz.exactReduction: Psi = e^{ik.x} W^{-3} b4^{-3/4} chi); it enters through the proper cell volume, i.e. Vol_7(a4,0) and with it the effective coupling lambda_hat/Vol_7(a4,0) ~ e^{-2 a4,0}, and through the history identity dE/da4 = -3 (P3 - P_t) - (3/2) beta P_t; the lambda = 0 states do not depend on b4
conventions.merminRoot: mu from sum g f = N with the well-conditioned residual of solver/src/mermin.rs: thermal particles above and holes below a split of the levels (complementary Fermi factors f(-x), never 1 - f), canonical form LogBalance (log-sum-exp balance, Newton + bisection), refined run LinearDeviation (an exactly equivalent form with a different rounding path); the former direct count sum g f - N fixed mu only to eps_mach N/(dN/dmu) (8.3e-10 m in N8_lamm1_a00_T10)
conventions.deltaScf: first excited state: one particle moved from the highest occupied degenerate group to the lowest empty group, spread uniformly over each group (ensemble Delta-SCF, keeps the block and direction symmetry of the reduction)
conventions.exactExchange: canonical functional = Hartree + exact local exchange of the uniform 8-fold gas (exact at every temperature for p -> -p symmetric occupations); the exact Fock exchange of the closed-shell slab determinant differs by +lambda Q^2/32 (reported as deltaE_x and solved as a variant)
